description: Explicit public replacements for all 47 unique internal-bearing provenance values approved for G-56. Original values remain in internal_provenance migration records.

replacements.O19 keeps the absolute threshold: an imp: The absolute threshold is retained because an impurity plus finite bath is not translationally extensive, so a per-site rule is not physically meaningful.
replacements.Real plane-wave UEG FCIDUMP; H1 includes: Real plane-wave UEG FCIDUMP; the one-body term includes kinetic energy plus v_M/2 on every spatial orbital so the N-electron Hamiltonian carries N*v_M/2.
replacements.O14 makes ED primary for W3b; existing r: Sparse exact diagonalization is primary for these tasks; existing real-root scans are retained only as non-blocking diagnostics and do not validate the emitted target sectors.
replacements.analysis/qsz_hubbard_2d_halffilled/qsz_4: Local same-Hamiltonian generic-reader FCI calculation on the emitted FCIDUMP.
replacements.work/fcidumps/propane_sto3g/source/C3H8_: CCSD/STO-3G source output used to construct the archived geometry.
replacements.C8 spec requires 1D chain references fro: The 1D chain reference must come from finite-system Lieb-Wu/Bethe numerics. The current value is inherited from an earlier staged record and is not yet accepted as the exact reference.

The 1D chain reference must come from finite-system Lieb-Wu/Bethe numerics. The current value is inherited from an earlier staged record and is not yet accepted as the exact reference. The reference energy is currently null.
replacements.Candidate staging only. Upstream provide: Candidate staging only. Upstream provides scripts and results rather than FCIDUMPs; the FCIDUMP was reconstructed with PySCF from the published method. Reference scope remains pending public curation.
replacements.Current square task is doped. The update: This square-lattice task is doped. Doped 2D Hubbard rows beyond exact-diagonalization reach use estimated references and are excluded from the hard tier.
replacements.Finite-size total energy in units t=1. O: Finite-size total energy in units t=1. The same-Hamiltonian 4x4 generic-reader FCI value is the exact reference. QSZ AFQMC remains a controlled cross-check with stochastic and constrained-path/Trotter caveats; the U/t=4 PBC printed-caption ED mismatch is documented as a source caveat.
replacements.C13 W3c analytic finite tight-binding co: Analytic finite tight-binding control: diagonalize the generated one-body hopping matrix and sum the lowest NELEC spin-orbital eigenvalues.
replacements.Cleland, Booth, Overy, and Alavi, J. Che: Cleland, Booth, Overy, and Alavi, J. Chem. Theory Comput. 8, 4138-4152 (2012), Table 1, dicarbon VDZ.

replacements.Finite-chain Bethe ansatz validation in: Finite-chain Bethe-ansatz value for V/t=1 (Delta=0.5), independently cross-checked against the corresponding VarBench exact-diagonalization result.

replacements.Lieb and Wu, Phys. Rev. Lett. 20, 1445 (: Lieb and Wu, Phys. Rev. Lett. 20, 1445 (1968), DOI 10.1103/PhysRevLett.20.1445; finite periodic-chain Bethe equations solved numerically and independently checked by exact diagonalization.
replacements.Local PySCF generic-reader FCI anchor on: Local PySCF generic-reader FCI calculation on the emitted FCIDUMP, treated as an exact same-Hamiltonian reference. QSZ Table IV AFQMC is retained as a controlled cross-check. For U/t=4 PBC, the QSZ caption ED mismatch is documented as a rounded-caption/source-defect caveat.
replacements.Local exact diagonalization of the same: Local exact diagonalization of the same finite downfolded model encoded in the FCIDUMP; the arXiv v3 / Phys. Rev. Applied paper reports DMRG 6.005 eV for the same 10x1 half-filled model and parameters.
replacements.None; originally from https://doi.org/10: No current reference energy; original source: https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0018577.
replacements.O14 W3b route: sparse Lanczos exact diag: Sparse Lanczos exact diagonalization of the same finite periodic site-basis Hubbard Hamiltonian emitted as FCIDUMP; Lieb-Wu real-root scans are non-blocking cross-checks only when same-target validation exists.
